## Highlights

- Make hidden-parameter discovery substantially more selective by grouping equivalent routes, retaining already-observed names without probing them again, and applying an independent endpoint/probe budget.
- Restrict Server-Side JavaScript Injection to Node.js and likely code-evaluation surfaces, reuse observed baselines, deduplicate route variants, and cap targets per origin.
- Feed persisted technology fingerprints into module planning so framework-, web-server-, protocol-, and platform-specific checks avoid irrelevant targets.
- Eliminate status-only HTTP request-smuggling confirmations: two independent attempts must each produce their own queued canary response.

## Accuracy and evidence

- Suppress generic parser failures such as `400 Invalid Header`, malformed requests, invalid transfer encodings and infrastructure errors as request-smuggling findings.
- Preserve the exact raw request bytes used by protocol-level smuggling evidence and omit misleading cURL reconstructions that cannot reproduce a desynchronized connection.
- Keep unrelated query or header parameter labels off host/path-level request-smuggling findings.
- Prefer Next.js and Nuxt fingerprints before the generic React signature so dedicated checks remain correctly scheduled.
- Group hidden-parameter network failures by cause, emit explicit coverage gaps, and fail the phase only when every selected endpoint fails.

## Scan efficiency and observability

- Apply deterministic module preconditions before work enters adaptive budgeting or worker queues.
- Add hard per-origin request limits and cache-aware accounting to IIS short-name, Nginx alias and Next.js testing.
- Reduce low-yield enumeration candidates and stop expensive checks after repeated blocking or infrastructure failures.
- Show crawled pages, discovered endpoints and sent requests as separate live counters.

## Install with Go

The `engine/v0.2.9` module tag makes both commands install this release:

```bash
go install github.com/akha-security/akca/engine/cmd/akca@v0.2.9
go install github.com/akha-security/akca/engine/cmd/akca@latest
```

## Downloads

- `akca-windows-amd64.exe` - Windows x64
- `akca-linux-amd64` - Linux x64
- `akca-linux-arm64` - Linux ARM64
- `akca-darwin-amd64` - macOS Intel
- `akca-darwin-arm64` - macOS Apple Silicon
- `SHA256SUMS.txt` - SHA-256 verification manifest

Release binaries include GitHub build-provenance attestations and can be verified with `gh attestation verify <binary> -R akha-security/akca`.

Browser-backed checks require Chrome, Chromium, or Edge. Use AKCA only against systems you own or are explicitly authorized to test.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/akha-security/akca/compare/v0.2.8...v0.2.9
